title: Cognyte Luminar Threat Intelligence
descriptionMarkdown: The Cognyte Luminar connector pulls STIX 2.1 indicators of compromise and their threat context (threat actors, identities and relationships) from the Luminar IOCs and Cyber Feeds collections and uploads them to Microsoft Sentinel threat intelligence through the STIX objects upload API. Data lands in the ThreatIntelIndicators and ThreatIntelObjects tables.

sampleQueries.description: All Cognyte Luminar indicators (latest version of each)
sampleQueries.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == 'Cognyte Luminar'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where IsDeleted == false
| project TimeGenerated, ObservableKey, ObservableValue, Confidence, ValidFrom, ValidUntil, Tags, Data

sampleQueries.description: Cognyte Luminar indicators by observable type
sampleQueries.query:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == 'Cognyte Luminar'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by Id
| where IsDeleted == false
| summarize count() by ObservableKey

sampleQueries.description: Cognyte Luminar threat actors and the identities they target

dataTypes.name: ThreatIntelIndicators
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == 'Cognyte Luminar'
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

dataTypes.name: ThreatIntelObjects
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
ThreatIntelObjects
| where SourceSystem == 'Cognyte Luminar'
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
ThreatIntelIndicators
| where SourceSystem == 'Cognyte Luminar'
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions on the workspace are required.

customs.name: Microsoft Entra application
customs.description: An app registration (Application ID, Tenant ID, Client Secret) granted the **Microsoft Sentinel Contributor** role on the Log Analytics workspace. This is required by the [threat intelligence upload API](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/sentinel/connect-threat-intelligence-upload-api).

customs.name: Microsoft.Web/sites permissions
customs.description: Read and write permissions to Azure Functions to create a Function App is required. [See the documentation to learn more about Azure Functions](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-functions/).

customs.name: Luminar API credentials
customs.description: **Luminar API Client ID**, **Luminar API Client Secret** and **Luminar API Account ID** are required. Contact luminar@cognyte.com for access.

instructionSteps.description: >**NOTE:** This connector uses Azure Functions to connect to the Cognyte Luminar TAXII API and upload STIX objects to Microsoft Sentinel threat intelligence (ThreatIntelIndicators and ThreatIntelObjects tables). This might result in additional costs for data ingestion and for Azure Functions and storage. Check the [Azure Functions pricing page](https://azure.microsoft.com/pricing/details/functions/) for details.

>**(Optional Step)** Securely store workspace and API authorization key(s) or token(s) in Azure Key Vault. Azure Key Vault provides a secure mechanism to store and retrieve key values. [Follow these instructions](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/app-service/app-service-key-vault-references) to use Azure Key Vault with an Azure Function App.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 1 - Register a Microsoft Entra application and grant it access to the workspace
instructionSteps.description:
1. In **Microsoft Entra ID > App registrations**, create a new registration and note the **Application (client) ID** and **Directory (tenant) ID**.
2. Under **Certificates & secrets**, create a client secret and copy its value.
3. Open the Log Analytics workspace used by Microsoft Sentinel, go to **Access control (IAM) > Add role assignment**, choose the **Microsoft Sentinel Contributor** role and assign it to the application.
4. Copy the **Workspace ID** below; it is required by the Function App.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 - Option 1 - Azure Resource Manager (ARM) Template for Flex Consumption Plan
instructionSteps.description:
Use this method for automated deployment of the data connector using an ARM Template.

1. Click the **Deploy to Azure** button below. 

	[![Deploy To Azure](https://aka.ms/deploytoazurebutton)](https://aka.ms/sentinel-CognyteLuminar-azuredeployflex)
2. Select the preferred **Subscription**, **Resource Group** and **Location**. 
3. Enter the **Application ID**, **Tenant ID**, **Client Secret**, **Workspace ID**, **Luminar API Client ID**, **Luminar API Account ID**, **Luminar API Client Secret**, **Luminar Initial Fetch Date** and **TimeInterval**. Leave **Luminar Base URL**, **Luminar Collections**, **Default Indicator Validity Days**, **Default Confidence** and **TLP Level** at their defaults unless Cognyte advised otherwise.
4. Mark the checkbox labeled **I agree to the terms and conditions stated above**.
5. Click **Purchase** to deploy.
